data.about: Fresh Gaia milk, collected from our partner farmers, chilled at the village centre and pasteurised and packed at our plant - so it reaches you fresh every morning. Great for tea, coffee, cereal or a warm glass at bedtime.
data.name: Gaia Toned Milk
data.storage: Keep refrigerated at or below 4°C. Boil before use and consume within 24 hours of opening.
